description: Beautiful apartment, located in "Le Marais", a historic parisian area in the very heart of Paris! A bottle of French wine is offered to you at your arrival as well as fresh sodas or water. You're Welcome!The spaceThis place is safe and clean, so you'll feel right at home with family and friends!Since Covid-19 we take every precaution between each guest to ensure that you are safe with us. Beautiful, spacious apartment located in "Le Marais", a historic Parisian district in the heart of Paris!The apartment is quiet, bright and fully equipped, and you'll love the tasteful decor. The three bedrooms are charming and bright, and the largest has a TV. The living room is very pleasant and comfortable, and also very bright. Everything is designed to accommodate your babies too. The building is secure (code + keys required) and there is a building manager. Close to several metro stations, the neighborhood is ideal for strolling and discovering beautiful places. A parking space can be provided by contacting the host.A bottle of French wine is offered on arrival, as well as fresh sodas or mineral water. Just read the comments of those who came before you :).We wish you an excellent stay! Regards, YohannGuest accessGuests have access to the entire apartment.They will be assisted by a dedicated team, Aurélie and Matthieu, who can help before and during the stay and answer any questions they may have.Check-in is organized through a secure KeyNest key collection system. On the morning of their arrival, guests will receive a unique KeyNest link and collection code, together with all the necessary instructions to pick up the keys.Check-out is self-managed.
